Both traces solve the puzzle by identifying S8 as the unique entry point and following the implication chain to a complete assignment. Their main divergences are in the hypothetical branches they explore. Trace 1 explores the consequence of ignoring the certification constraints (e.g., S8=Ed) to confirm they are necessary, whereas Trace 2 does not explore this. Trace 2 explores the hypothetical where S7 is not Ed to confirm the chain is forced, whereas Trace 1 does not. Neither branch pays off; both are eliminated and serve only to verify the main chain. Both traces also rework the main implication chain verbatim after the initial deduction.

⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="If we ignore the certification rules (3, 6, 8, 11), we have 5 options for S8." end="So S8 cannot be Ed. Same for S8 not being Ana, Bo, Di. So S8 must be Cy." basis=The trace opens a hypothetical branch where S8 is not Cy and explores S8=Ed, then explicitly eliminates it to confirm S8=Cy.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Let's check if there is any contradiction. Suppose I made a mistake in the implications." end="The logic holds up." basis=This span re-executes the implication chain from S8 to S2 verbatim, adding no new information.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=1 conf=clear start="Is it possible that S1 is NOT Ana?" end="So Ana leads S1." basis=The trace opens a branch questioning the S1 assignment and eliminates it by re-affirming the implication from S8.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="What if S7 was not Ed?" end="So S7 *must* be Ed. There is no alternative." basis=The trace opens a hypothetical branch where S7 is not Ed and explicitly eliminates it by tracing back to the forced S8 assignment.
⟦CYCLE⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="Is it possible for *someone else* to lead S8?" end="Therefore, **Cy MUST lead S8**." basis=The trace opens a branch considering alternative leaders for S8 and eliminates them by checking constraints.
⟦LOOP⟧ trace=2 conf=clear start="The logic chain:" end="The logic holds." basis=This span re-derives the implication chain from S8 to S2, adding no new information.
